purpose: Observed pre-refactor baseline for comparison, not an allowlist. The test runner must still return nonzero for every failing test.

execution.source: git archive HEAD; no runtime data or credentials copied
limitations: Windows symlink creation privilege was unavailable.
Installed ComfyUI source, live worker configuration and sibling embedded Python were not copied.
The baseline used loopback-only network guards. The repository runner isolates source, data and user directories but is not an OS network sandbox.
Post-refactor verification uses locked Playwright 1.64.1 with the same Edge version; account for this tooling difference when comparing browser outcomes.
Browser tests use local test interfaces; this is not real GPU generation or deployed-service validation.

web.note: Counts include aggregate parents and do not equal the number of independent production defects. Some timeout root causes remain uninvestigated.
